t01_new_prompt:
Do you want to save the changes to "at01" before starting a new project?

If you don't save, your changes will be lost.
t01_open_prompt:
Do you want to save the changes to "Untitled" before opening another project?

If you don't save, your changes will be lost.
t01_midi_prompt:
Do you want to save the changes to "Untitled" before replacing the song with a MIDI file?

If you don't save, your changes will be lost.
t01_drop_prompt:
Do you want to save the changes to "Untitled" before opening the dropped file?

If you don't save, your changes will be lost.
t01_close_prompt:
Do you want to save the changes to "Untitled" before closing?

If you don't save, your changes will be lost.

t04_prompt:
Switch the hardware profile to NES (2A03)? | NES (2A03) doesn't have the channels these locked tracks use:

"VRC6 Pulse 1" (VRC6 Pulse 1)
"VRC6 Pulse 2" (VRC6 Pulse 2)
"VRC6 Saw" (VRC6 Saw)

Unlock them to keep them playing as studio tracks, or switch anyway: they stay locked, dimmed and silent until you switch back.
